source: Good Sam directory (PUBLIC_PARK and local-named rows with no entry within 2 km) and every named OSM tourism=camp_site/caravan_site with no entry within 1.5 km, read by name
note: Two local-government campgrounds added, both from Good Sam public-park rows: Winter Island Park (City of Salem) and Bourne Scenic Park (Bourne Recreation Authority, on USACE land). The rest of Massachusetts' 104 unmatched OSM campsites are private, Trustees, DCR or military.
